title: FAIDER: Fairness-Aware Item-Level Decoding for Large Language Model Recommenders
abstract: arXiv:2611.10285v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) recommenders can produce semantically different recommendations when a user's protected attribute changes, even if the interaction history remains fixed. Controlling this disparity is challenging when model weights and full-vocabulary logits are inaccessible. We propose FAIDER (Fairness-Aware Item-level DEcoding for Recommendation), which incorporates fairness into list construction by selecting complete item candidates rather than manipulating token-level logits or repeatedly repairing finished outputs. The central idea is to separate the operational criterion for a violation from how strongly generation is constrained. Conformal-inspired empirical calibration fixes a cross-group semantic-disparity threshold, while online decoding applies either hard filtering or a soft penalty adjusted through dual-inspired feedback to target a prescribed violation rate. translated_title: FAIDER：面向大语言模型推荐系统的公平感知条目级解码
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）推荐系统在用户的受保护属性发生变化时，即使交互历史保持不变，也可能产生语义上不同的推荐结果。当模型权重和完整词表的logits不可访问时，控制这种差异极具挑战性。我们提出了FAIDER（面向推荐的公平感知条目级解码），它通过选择完整的候选条目将公平性融入列表构建过程，而不是操纵词元级别的logits或反复修复已生成的输出。其核心思想是将违规的操作性判据与生成被约束的强度分离开来：受保形（conformal）方法启发的经验校准确定一个跨组语义差异阈值，而在线解码则应用硬过滤，或通过对偶启发的反馈进行调节的软惩罚，以达到预先规定的违规率。此外，我们还建立了一项路径层面的保证：未……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: FAIDER针对无法访问模型权重和词表logits的大语言模型推荐系统，提出条目级解码方法，通过保形启发的校准确定跨组语义差异阈值，并在解码中结合硬过滤或对偶启发的软惩罚来控制公平性违规率。
en_tdlr: FAIDER enables fairness control for LLM recommenders without access to model weights or full-vocabulary logits by selecting complete item candidates during decoding, using conformal-inspired calibration to set a cross-group semantic-disparity threshold and applying hard filtering or dual-inspired soft penalties to target a prescribed violation rate.
